market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR are the defending 2024 champions with a strong retained core (Iyer, Russell, Narine, Chakravarthy) and are a top-tier IPL side. In a 10-team league with high variance, a strong team typically has around a 10% chance of winning any given season. The market price of 1.3% is significantly below this, representing a clear mispricing.
evidence_points: KKR won the 2024 IPL with the same core likely intact through the 2025–2026 cycle.
Implied win probability for an average team is 10%, and KKR is above average.
The 2025 mega auction retention rules kept key players, and 2026 squads will be similar, mitigating uncertainty.
